notes.title: Release date UPDATE: February 21st 2025!
notes.notes:
Hello, Iridio fans!

Just a quick update to share on the release timeline for Iridio Prologue:
we are still waiting for the final Steam approval (it's taking longer than usual), and to ensure a smooth and polished experience, we’re moving the release date to [b]February 21st, 2025[/b].

A new TRAILER is live, showing part of the gameplay and the first fully playable game zone.

The Early Access launch for Iridio is still set to take place in Q2 2025, with the full game targeted for an April/May release.

We appreciate your ongoing support and patience as we work to make Iridio the best experience possible. Thank you for being on this journey with us! 💚🤍

KR Games Team

notes.title: New release date: January 10th 2025!
notes.notes:
Hello, Iridio fans!

We have a quick update to share on the release timeline for Iridio Prologue. 
To ensure a smooth and polished experience, we’re moving the release date to [b]January 10, 2025[/b].

Additionally, the Early Access launch for Iridio will now take place in Q2 2025, with the full game targeted for an April/May release.

We appreciate your ongoing support and patience as we work to make Iridio the best experience possible. Thank you for being on this journey with us! 💚🤍

KR Games Team
